responsibility: Provides the top-level Rust AST-to-HIR lowering driver and the out-of-line implementations for shared lowering routines that span multiple headers. It translates an AST crate into an HIR::Crate by iterating items, implements visibility desugaring into HIR::Visibility and restricted SimplePath forms, and defines the concrete lowering logic for block-oriented expression visitors, path-in-expression and qualified-path lowering, and closure-parameter conversion. This is the orchestration unit that ties together the specialized lowerers into a complete crate-level HIR construction pass.
same_name_distinction: Contains the crate-level lowering driver and shared cross-cutting lowering implementations such as visibility desugaring, block/if/match expression lowering, expression-path lowering, and closure-parameter conversion; rust-ast-lower.h is only the small public facade for invoking that pass.
